platforms.metaDescription: Get Respondus LockDown Browser help with downloads, system checks, Windows, Mac and Canvas setup, plus guidance for preparing before your exam.
platforms.tagline: Find complete Respondus LockDown Browser setup advice, system checks, Windows and Mac troubleshooting, Canvas/Blackboard launch instructions, and pre-exam preparation coaching.
platforms.description: Find complete Respondus LockDown Browser setup advice, system checks, Windows and Mac troubleshooting, Canvas/Blackboard launch instructions, and pre-exam preparation coaching.
platforms.overview: Respondus LockDown Browser is a custom web browser that locks down the testing environment within Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, and Moodle. When an assessment requires LockDown Browser, students cannot print, copy, visit other websites, or open secondary desktop applications during testing. While LockDown Browser secures the local computer environment, Respondus Monitor is an optional automated add-on that records webcam video and audio. Software requirements and permitted aids depend entirely on your institution's and course instructor's exam settings. We help students prepare for exams that use Respondus LockDown Browser through subject tutoring, practice-question walkthroughs and pre-exam technical guidance.
keyFeatures: Blocks web browsers, messaging apps, and screen-sharing utilities during testing
Disables task switching, right-click menus, and copy-paste keyboard shortcuts
Integrates directly with university Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, and Brightspace courses
Optional Respondus Monitor automated webcam recording and facial detection checks

systemRequirements.windows: 64-bit Windows 11 or Windows 10 (version 1607 or higher). Standard desktop edition.
systemRequirements.chromebook: ChromeOS with the official Respondus extension explicitly enabled by institution administrator.
systemRequirements.iOS: iPadOS 12.0+ (Only if specifically enabled by course instructor in LMS LockDown Browser Dashboard).
systemRequirements.hardware: 1024x768 minimum resolution, 4 GB RAM, 200 MB free storage, functional webcam and microphone for Respondus Monitor.

troubleshooting.issue: Error: "You must close the following applications before starting..."
troubleshooting.solution: Open Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS) and end processes like Spotify, Teams, Skype, Discord, or Grammarly prior to launching your test.

troubleshooting.issue: Webcam check fails or shows a black camera preview screen
troubleshooting.solution: Verify OS privacy permissions. On macOS Ventura/Sonoma/Sequoia, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera. On macOS Monterey, check System Preferences > Security & Privacy. On Windows 11/10, check Settings > Privacy > Camera.

troubleshooting.issue: Stuck on "Loading Exam" or password prompt appears
troubleshooting.solution: Never enter a password manually. Clear your default browser cache, restart your router, and launch the exam directly from your course LMS quiz page.

faqs.question: Where can I download Respondus LockDown Browser?
faqs.answer: You must download LockDown Browser using the unique installer link provided on your university or college LMS quiz page (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, or Brightspace). Do not download generic installers from third-party websites, as each university installer contains institution-specific configuration files.

faqs.question: How do students use Respondus LockDown Browser?
faqs.answer: Students log into their university LMS using Google Chrome or Safari, navigate to their course quiz page, and click "Take the Quiz". The quiz automatically prompts LockDown Browser to open, lock down desktop applications, and initiate pre-test webcam checks if required.

faqs.question: How do I run the system or webcam check?
faqs.answer: Before launching your exam, run your instructor's non-graded Practice Quiz in Canvas or Blackboard. The Practice Quiz guides you through the automated startup sequence: Webcam Check, Student Photo, Photo ID Capture, Environment Scan, and Facial Detection Check.

faqs.question: Why is LockDown Browser not working on Windows 11?
faqs.answer: On Windows 11, launch failures are usually caused by background communications apps (Discord, Teams, Spotify), missing camera permissions (Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera > Allow desktop apps), or third-party antivirus overlays. Running the installer as Administrator resolves most setup blocks.

faqs.question: Why is LockDown Browser not working on my Mac?
faqs.answer: On macOS, launch failures usually stem from missing camera/microphone permissions. On macOS Ventura/Sonoma/Sequoia, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera. On macOS Monterey, check System Preferences > Security & Privacy > Camera. If missing, re-run your university installer or reset camera privacy permissions via Terminal using tccutil reset Camera.

faqs.question: How do I launch a Canvas exam using LockDown Browser?
faqs.answer: Log into Canvas using Google Chrome or Safari, navigate to your course, open the Quizzes tab, select your exam, and click "Take the Quiz". Canvas will automatically launch LockDown Browser and lock your screen.

faqs.question: Where is the LockDown Browser Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The LockDown Browser Dashboard is an instructor-only tool located inside Canvas, Blackboard, or Moodle. Course instructors use the Dashboard to enable LockDown Browser, require Respondus Monitor, set calculator permissions, or allow iPad access for specific quizzes.

faqs.question: How do I contact official Respondus support?
faqs.answer: Students can visit the official Respondus Knowledge Base at https://web.respondus.com/he/lockdownbrowser/ or submit a technical support ticket at https://support.respondus.com/. For active exam emergencies or password issues, contact your university IT helpdesk or course professor immediately.

faqs.question: Can Tutor Proctored Exams help me prepare for a Respondus exam?
faqs.answer: Yes! We help students prepare for exams that use Respondus LockDown Browser through subject tutoring, practice-question walkthroughs and pre-exam technical guidance. Explore our Software Technical Guidance, Academic Exam Preparation, and One-on-One Tutoring services.

Examplify delivers exams offline after downloading the secure exam file, blocking access to all background applications, internet browsing, and files during the examination.
platforms.overview: Examplify (developed by ExamSoft) is a secure testing application used extensively across US law schools, medical schools, nursing colleges, and state bar examinations. Examplify delivers exams offline after downloading the secure exam file, blocking access to all background applications, internet browsing, and files during the examination.

systemRequirements.windows: 64-bit versions of Windows 10 and Windows 11. (ARM processors and Windows S mode not supported).
systemRequirements.chromebook: Not supported. Examplify requires native Windows or macOS operating systems.
systemRequirements.iOS: iPadOS 15.0+ supported for specific institutional deployments only.
systemRequirements.hardware: Minimum 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended), 4 GB available hard drive space, 1366x768 screen resolution, working webcam.

keyFeatures: Offline exam delivery preventing internet dependency during test taking
Complete computer lockdown blocking external software and files
Automated encrypted answer file upload upon exam completion
Integrated spell-checking, essay word counters, and highlight tools

troubleshooting.issue: Unable to download exam file ("Download Limit Exceeded" or error code)
troubleshooting.solution: Contact your institution’s exam administrator or tech desk to request an exam download re-enablement.

troubleshooting.issue: Examplify freezes during launch or password entry
troubleshooting.solution: Restart your laptop, run Examplify as Administrator (Windows), and ensure no virtual machines or remote desktop tools are running.

troubleshooting.issue: Answer upload fails after completing the exam
troubleshooting.solution: Connect your computer to a stable Wi-Fi network or phone hotspot and click "Retry Upload". Your answers remain securely encrypted on your hard drive.

faqs.question: Do I need a continuous internet connection during an Examplify test?
faqs.answer: Usually no. Internet is required only to download the encrypted exam file before starting and to upload your answer file after finishing.

faqs.question: Can I take an Examplify test on a Chromebook or Surface RT?
faqs.answer: No. Examplify requires standard 64-bit versions of Windows 10/11 or modern macOS. Chromebooks and Windows S-Mode devices are unsupported.

faqs.question: What should I do if my answer file fails to upload after an exam?
faqs.answer: Connect your laptop to a stable Wi-Fi network or mobile hotspot and click "Retry Upload". Your answers remain securely encrypted on your hard drive.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I download my Examplify exam file?
faqs.answer: We recommend downloading your exam file as soon as your institution opens the download window, ideally 24 to 48 hours before test day.

faqs.question: Why does Examplify freeze or prompt for a password on launch?
faqs.answer: Launch freezes are usually caused by background antivirus full scans, virtual machines, or remote desktop software running in the background.

faqs.question: How do I prepare effectively for Examplify law or nursing exams?
faqs.answer: We offer structured subject coaching, practice question walkthroughs, and study strategies tailored for law school and nursing candidates.

It is widely used by US colleges and universities to provide automated and live-triggered proctoring for exams within Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, and ulterior assessment systems without requiring software downloads outside Google Chrome.

systemRequirements.chromebook: ChromeOS 90+ fully supported via Google Chrome browser extension.
systemRequirements.iOS: Not supported for taking exams; Chrome extension required on desktop/laptop/Chromebook.
systemRequirements.hardware: Google Chrome browser (latest version), functional webcam, microphone, stable internet connection (min 1.5 Mbps upload/download).

keyFeatures: Zero software download required—runs entirely within Google Chrome
AI-assisted audio and webcam monitoring with live proctor intervention
ID verification and 360-degree room environment scans
Multi-device detection technology to protect test integrity

troubleshooting.issue: Chrome extension popup fails to load or hangs on "Connecting..."
troubleshooting.solution: Disable third-party ad blockers or privacy extensions in Chrome, clear cache, and ensure Google Chrome is updated.

troubleshooting.issue: Webcam or microphone not detected by Honorlock
troubleshooting.solution: Click the lock icon in the Chrome address bar and ensure Camera and Microphone permissions are set to "Allow".

troubleshooting.issue: Prompted for a password during an exam launch
troubleshooting.solution: You should not enter a password manually. Honorlock automatically inserts the password when launched correctly through your LMS.

faqs.question: Does Honorlock work on Safari, Edge, or Firefox?
faqs.answer: No. Honorlock operates exclusively within the Google Chrome web browser using the official Honorlock Chrome extension.

faqs.question: Can I take an Honorlock exam on a Chromebook?
faqs.answer: Yes! Chromebooks are fully supported for Honorlock as long as you use the official Google Chrome browser with the extension installed.

faqs.question: Why is Honorlock prompting me for an exam password?
faqs.answer: You should not enter a password manually. Temporarily disable ad-blockers, clear Chrome cache, or launch the exam directly from your LMS quiz page so Honorlock inserts the password automatically.

faqs.question: What is required during an Honorlock 360-degree room scan?
faqs.answer: You must slowly rotate your webcam to show your entire desk surface, under the desk, and the room perimeter to verify no unauthorized study aids are present.

faqs.question: Does Honorlock require downloading an executable .exe or .dmg file?
faqs.answer: No. Honorlock runs entirely inside Google Chrome without requiring external desktop software installations.

faqs.question: How can TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS help me prepare for Honorlock exams?
faqs.answer: We provide subject tutoring, mock practice tests, time management coaching, and guidance on satisfying room and hardware requirements.

systemRequirements.chromebook: Supported for select automated exams via Chrome extension; not supported for live proctored exams requiring Guardian Browser.

24/7 appointment scheduling and technician support
Secure ID verification and workspace environment scanning

troubleshooting.issue: Technician cannot connect to your screen or video stream
troubleshooting.solution: Temporarily disable firewall or VPN software, grant screen recording permissions under macOS System Preferences, and restart Chrome or Guardian Browser.

troubleshooting.issue: Equipment test fails on RAM or CPU usage
troubleshooting.solution: Close high-memory applications like Chrome tabs, video editors, or cloud sync tools prior to connecting.

troubleshooting.issue: Disconnections during the live session
troubleshooting.solution: Use a wired Ethernet cable instead of Wi-Fi if possible, and reconnect immediately through your ProctorU account dashboard.

faqs.question: Are headsets or earbuds allowed during a ProctorU exam?
faqs.answer: Generally no. Most ProctorU exams require open speakers and an internal/external microphone so the proctor can hear ambient room sounds.

faqs.question: What is the Guardian Browser?
faqs.answer: The Guardian Browser is Meazure Learning’s secure browser application designed specifically to deliver ProctorU live proctored exams.

faqs.question: What should I do if the technician cannot connect to my webcam or screen?
faqs.answer: Temporarily disable corporate VPNs or strict firewalls, grant Screen Recording and Camera permissions in OS settings, and restart Guardian Browser.

faqs.question: What internet upload speed is required for ProctorU live exams?
faqs.answer: ProctorU recommends a minimum upload and download speed of 3.0 Mbps over a stable connection (wired Ethernet recommended over Wi-Fi).

faqs.question: Can I take a ProctorU exam on a dual-monitor setup?
faqs.answer: No. ProctorU requires physically disconnecting all secondary monitors before your live proctoring session begins.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS support ProctorU test takers?
faqs.answer: We offer comprehensive subject coaching, practice exams, time management, and pre-test equipment review to ensure full readiness.

platforms.overview: Proctorio is an automated remote proctoring solution operating as a Google Chrome extension. systemRequirements.iOS: Not supported for taking proctored exams.
systemRequirements.hardware: Google Chrome browser, functioning webcam, microphone, minimum 2 GB RAM, 1 Mbps internet connection.

keyFeatures: Zero software installation outside the Google Chrome extension
Automated identity verification and facial recognition checks
Flexible proctoring settings configured directly by course instructors
Encrypted video and lockdown recording stored securely in LMS

troubleshooting.issue: Prompted for an exam access code or password
troubleshooting.solution: Re-install the Proctorio extension, clear Chrome cache, or ensure you are launching the test from inside your official LMS quiz page.

troubleshooting.issue: "Webcam not detected" or resolution check fails
troubleshooting.solution: Allow Chrome camera permissions in your operating system settings and close other applications using the webcam.

troubleshooting.issue: Extension uninstalling or crashing repeatedly
troubleshooting.solution: Update Google Chrome to the latest stable release and remove conflicting browser extensions.

faqs.question: Is there a live human proctor watching me during a Proctorio exam?
faqs.answer: No. Proctorio relies on automated encryption and algorithmic recording, which is reviewed asynchronously by your course instructor if flagged.

faqs.question: Why does Proctorio prompt for an access code or password?
faqs.answer: Access code prompts occur when the extension is disabled or out of date. Re-enable Proctorio in Chrome extensions, clear cache, and launch directly from your LMS quiz page.

faqs.question: Does Proctorio work on mobile phones or tablets?
faqs.answer: No. Proctorio requires a laptop, desktop, or Chromebook running Google Chrome.

faqs.question: What triggers automated camera flags during a Proctorio exam?
faqs.answer: Flags are triggered by looking off-screen repeatedly, low room lighting, secondary ambient voices, or moving out of the camera view.

faqs.question: Does Proctorio access my personal private files?
faqs.answer: No. Proctorio only records webcam, microphone, and screen activity during the active exam session within your browser.

faqs.question: How can TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS help me with Proctorio exams?

troubleshooting.issue: Onboarding face scan continuously rejected
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust room lighting so light illuminates your face directly, remove hats or dark glasses, and face the camera straight on.

troubleshooting.issue: App flags unauthorized background applications
troubleshooting.solution: Close communication software, cloud synchronization tools, and extra background helpers using your system process manager.

troubleshooting.issue: Download or installation error on macOS
troubleshooting.solution: Open macOS Security & Privacy settings and allow installation of the Proctortrack application.

faqs.question: What is Proctortrack Onboarding?
faqs.answer: Onboarding is a baseline setup scan where Proctortrack approves your face identity and student ID before you can take real graded exams.

faqs.question: Why does my Proctortrack onboarding face scan keep failing?
faqs.answer: Face scan failures are usually caused by low or backlit room lighting, dark glasses, or sitting at an angle. Ensure lighting illuminates your face directly.

faqs.question: What background apps does Proctortrack block?
faqs.answer: Proctortrack blocks messaging software, screen recorders, cloud backup utilities, and remote desktop applications during testing.

faqs.question: Is Proctortrack supported on Chromebooks?
faqs.answer: Proctortrack support on Chromebooks depends on your institution’s configuration. Standard Windows 10/11 or Mac laptops are strongly recommended.

faqs.question: Does Proctortrack record my screen during the exam?
faqs.answer: Yes. Proctortrack captures webcam video, microphone audio, and desktop screen activity during active testing sessions.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS assist Proctortrack candidates?

faqs.question: Why is the "Connect" button grayed out on my Examity dashboard?

faqs.question: What should I do if pop-ups block my Examity session launch?

faqs.question: Can I take an Examity live proctored exam on a Chromebook?

faqs.question: What ID is required during Examity live authentication?

Live human proctor authentication and session oversight
Strict adherence to national licensing board regulations

troubleshooting.issue: PSI Secure Browser download fails or gets blocked by Windows Defender
troubleshooting.solution: Select "Run Anyway" or add an exception in your antivirus software for the official PSI installer.

troubleshooting.issue: Proctor requests second room scan due to lighting
troubleshooting.solution: Ensure overhead lighting is bright and remove any reflective surfaces near your desk.

troubleshooting.issue: System compatibility check fails on network speed
troubleshooting.solution: Disconnect other household devices from Wi-Fi or plug in an Ethernet cable directly.

faqs.question: What is the Candidate Information Bulletin (CIB)?
faqs.answer: The CIB is the official candidate handbook issued by your state licensing board detailing exam content rules, time limits, and allowed reference materials.

faqs.question: Can I use dual monitors during a PSI remote licensing exam?
faqs.answer: No. Dual monitors are strictly forbidden during PSI Bridge remote exams and must be physically unplugged before the session starts.

faqs.question: What should I do if Windows Defender blocks the PSI Secure Browser installer?
faqs.answer: Select "More Info" and click "Run Anyway" or add an antivirus exception for the official PSI installer downloaded from your licensing portal.

faqs.question: Are Chromebooks supported for PSI Bridge remote proctored exams?
faqs.answer: No. PSI Bridge remote testing requires 64-bit Windows 10/11 or macOS 11+. Chromebooks and mobile tablets are unsupported.

faqs.question: What forms of ID are required for PSI licensing examinations?

faqs.question: What subjects are covered on the ATI TEAS version 7 exam?
faqs.answer: The TEAS 7 covers four core domains: Reading, Mathematics, Science (Anatomy & Physiology, Chemistry, Biology, Scientific Reasoning), and English & Language Usage.

faqs.question: Can I use physical scratch paper during a remote proctored TEAS exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, if permitted by your nursing program. Usually, one sheet of blank paper or an approved dry-erase whiteboard is allowed after proctor inspection.

faqs.question: Are Chromebooks supported for remote ATI TEAS exams?
faqs.answer: Yes. Remote TEAS exams administered via the official Chrome extension support Chromebooks running ChromeOS.

faqs.question: What should I do if my webcam disconnects during the TEAS Science section?

faqs.question: How far in advance should I log into my ATI student portal on test day?
